| Month | John | Kate | Jack | Emma | Luke |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| April | 15 | 15 | 10 | 10 | 0 |
| May | 10 | 0 | 15 | 15 | 10 |
| June | 0 | 10 | 15 | 10 | 15 |
| July | 10 | 15 | 0 | 15 | 10 |
| August | 15 | 10 | 10 | 0 | 15 |

That gives everyone 50 tons over five months and keeps each month’s total at 50. Let’s review the reported catches together each month and adjust the total downward if the lake starts below 100 tons—we need at least 50 left to replenish fully. Luke, does this schedule work for you?
